reason: The lab report for my batch on the page and the money-back guarantee make it a low-risk try at $24.99, and the sachets are easy to toss in my bag. I would only buy it once to see if I sleep better.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and I am not sure I will stick with it for 30 days. I also have no way to know if it works for me.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing someone with my sleep problem using it and getting results, or a one capsule dose.
